exams.notes: Required for licensure as a professional engineer by examination. Passing grade determined by engineering committee.
exams.quote: has passed the principles and practice of engineering examination administered by the national council of examiners for engineering and surveying relevant to the discipline in which the applicant is seeking licensure

interval_years.quote: Licensure shall be for a period of two years as prescribed in the rules of procedure.

required.quote: licensure renewal is accomplished upon payment of the required fee and satisfactory completion of the requirements of professional development.

available.quote: Licensure as a professional engineer may be either through examination or through endorsement or comity.

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed as an engineer in another state, DC, or US territory where standards equaled or exceeded NM standards at initial licensure; or licensed in a foreign country with equivalent standards; or (for non-structural disciplines) actively licensed for 10 continuous years, no disciplinary action in past 5 years, no suspensions/revocations, and passed the PE exam.
requirements.quote: An applicant may be licensed by endorsement or comity if the applicant: (1) is currently licensed as an engineer in another state, the District of Columbia or a territory of the United States; provided that the licensure does not conflict with the provisions of the Engineering and Surveying Practice Act and that the standards required by the licensure or the applicant's qualifications equaled or exceeded the licensure standards in New Mexico at the time the applicant was initially licensed

exists.quote: There is created the "state board of licensure for professional engineers and professional surveyors" that shall consist of five licensed professional engineers, at least one of whom shall be in engineering education, three licensed professional surveyors and two public members.

regulatory_model.quote: any person in either public or private capacity practicing or offering to practice engineering or surveying shall be required to submit evidence that the person is qualified to so practice and shall be licensed as provided in the Engineering and Surveying Practice Act.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue licenses pursuant to the provisions of the Engineering and Surveying Practice Act.

is_mandatory.quote: A valid license is required for a person to act as a professional engineer or to solicit or propose to perform work involving the practice of engineering.

title_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice, offer to practice, engage in the business, act in the capacity of, advertise or use in connection with the person's name or otherwise assume, use or advertise any title or description tending to convey the impression that the person is a professional, licensed engineer or surveyor unless that person is licensed or exempt under the provisions of the Engineering and Surveying Practice Act.

definition_quote.value: "engineering" or "practice of engineering" means any creative or engineering work that requires engineering education, training and experience in the application of engineering principles and the interpretation of engineering data to such creative work as consultation, investigation, forensic investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, expert technical testimony, engineering studies and the review of construction for the purpose of ensuring substantial compliance with drawings and specifications; any of which embrace such creative work, either public or private, in connection with any utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, work systems, projects and industrial or consumer products or equipment of a mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, chemical, pneumatic, environmental or thermal nature, insofar as they involve safeguarding life, health or property, and including such other professional services as may be necessary to the planning, progress and completion of engineering work.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: "surveyor intern" means a person who is certified as a surveyor intern by the board and who has qualified for, taken and passed an examination in the fundamentals of surveying subjects

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "responsible charge" means responsibility for the direction, control and supervision of engineering or surveying work, as the case may be, to ensure that the work product has been critically examined and evaluated for compliance with appropriate professional standards by a licensee in that profession, and by sealing or signing the documents, the professional engineer or professional surveyor accepts responsibility for the engineering or surveying work, respectively, represented by the documents and that applicable engineering or surveying standards have been met

seal_required_on_documents.quote: All plans, designs, drawings, specifications or reports that are involved in such practice, or that are issued by or for the practice, shall bear the seal and signature of the professional engineer in responsible charge of and directly responsible for the work issued.

seal_document_types.quote: All plans, designs, drawings, specifications or reports that are involved in such practice, or that are issued by or for the practice, shall bear the seal and signature of the professional engineer in responsible charge of and directly responsible for the work issued.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: Professional engineers may engage in the practice of engineering and perform engineering work pursuant to the Engineering and Surveying Practice Act as individuals or through a business entity.

value: Licensed architects practicing engineering incidental to their work (with restrictions)

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A New Mexico licensed architect who has complied with all of the laws of New Mexico relating to the practice of architecture has the right to engage in the incidental practice, as defined by regulation, of activities properly classified as engineering

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board shall promulgate rules of professional responsibility for professional engineers and professional surveyors that are not exclusive to the practice of engineering or exclusive to the practice of surveying.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Each shall have been engaged in the lawful practice of engineering as a professional engineer for at least ten years, including responsible charge of engineering projects for at least five years as a professional engineer licensed in New Mexico
